holdout.note: Frame list frozen by digest; not fetched or evaluated in AERIS-007.

onnx.reproducible: a second export in the same environment was byte-identical

pretraining_overlap: YOLOX-S weights were trained on COCO 2017; AOT frames are not part of COCO, so no image overlap is known. Domain overlap: COCO has an 'airplane' class and no helicopter class.

false_positive_breakdown.definition: detections at or above the frozen threshold with no scored aircraft at IoU >= 0.5, by what they overlap (first matching category)

missed_aircraft.definition: scored aircraft with no aircraft detection at IoU >= 0.5 and score >= the frozen threshold; covered = an unmapped COCO class candidate at or above the threshold overlaps it at IoU >= 0.5 (most frequent class counted)

diagnostics.post_hoc_note: false_positive_breakdown and loose_iou were added after the baseline results were first seen (visual inspection showed detections that include rotors and tails around fuselage-only labels). They are diagnostics; the frozen gate is unchanged.

retrieval.images: GET <bucket_url>/<key>; check the S3 ETag (MD5) and the SHA-256 here
